events.title: Noah & The Cosmic Cleanup at Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Noah & The Cosmic Cleanup is part of the October Steam Next Fest. From October 19 to 26 you can play the free demo: the game's first episode, set on the planet Bubbleon. Noah is an alien sloth whose boss, Vex, sends him to clean up a bubble planet overrun by the Odorax. 3D platforming, time control, puzzles and a whole town of Bubbleons who love a chat. events.title: Demo update: a more accessible, easier-to-follow Noah
events.summary: Thank you to everyone who played the Noah & The Cosmic Cleanup demo on Steam and at SAGA Barcelona. Watching so many people play made one thing clear: it wasn't always obvious where to go or what was left to do, and the controls asked too much. We want anyone to be able to enjoy Noah, whether it's their first platformer or not, on a controller or a keyboard. That's why this update is all about accessibility. events.title: What's next for Noah after SAGA Barcelona
events.summary: We just got back from SAGA Barcelona Game Fest, where lots of people played Noah & The Cosmic Cleanup at our booth. Thanks to everyone who came by, and to everyone who has already played the demo on Steam: you've given us a ton of feedback and we're reading all of it. The demo is a work in progress, and some things aren't where we want them yet. Here's what's coming: Intro cutscene: right now you're seeing the storyboard panels with voice-over. events.title: The Noah & The Cosmic Cleanup demo is out now!
events.summary: The Noah & The Cosmic Cleanup demo is now free to download on Steam. You are Noah, an alien sloth working as a galactic janitor. A dimensional rift has linked Bubbleon, the planet of cleanliness, to Odoria, and the stinky Odorax are filling everything with gas. Grab your vacuum and get to work. What's in the demo 3D platforming: jump, glide with your jetpack and teleport. Freeze, speed up or rewind objects to clear your path. Vacuum up gas bombs and trap the Odorax in bubbles. events.title: Noah & The Cosmic Cleanup at SAGA Barcelona Game Fest
events.summary: From October 9 to 11 we are bringing Noah & The Cosmic Cleanup to SAGA Barcelona Game Fest, at Fira de Barcelona Montjuïc. Come play the demo at our booth and tell us what you think. When and where Friday, October 9: trade day. Saturday 10 and Sunday 11 October: open to the public, 10:00 to 22:00. Fira de Barcelona Montjuïc, Palau 1. Win a Noah plush Drop by the booth, play the demo and have the game on your Steam wishlist to enter the draw for a Noah plush. We draw the winner live at the show.

events.title: Noah's soundtrack wins a medal at the Global Music Awards!
events.summary: At The Boltage Studio, our composer José Conejero has won the Bronze Medal at the prestigious Global Music Awards 2026.The award recognizes his outstanding work on the track “Protocol Noah: Cleanup”, part of the original soundtrack for our upcoming game Noah & the Cosmic Cleanup, currently in development at our studio in Vigo.José, trained at the Conservatorio Superior de Música de Galicia, continues to prove that Galician talent can shine on the international stage.
